title: FW: Posting at Noon, plus Superintendent's Parent Letter Draft

fields.cc: Margo Teller, RN (District Nurse Coordinator); Sunita Reddy, RN, CIC (MRMC Infection Prevention); MCHD Nurse Manager <nursemanager@marlowcountyia.example>
fields.subject: FW: Posting at noon — and Homecoming / parent letter DRAFT
fields.note:
Good morning,

I saw the hospital's note below, so I'm sending ours on the same thread so you have everything in one place.

Our letter to all families is attached. It says "dozens of students sickened by bad coleslaw at the Heritage Days supper." We're at 23 students and 6 staff out today, so "dozens" is fair. The parents are hearing "coleslaw" everywhere already.

We plan to cancel Tuesday's homecoming game and send the letter at 13:00, in English. The Spanish version will follow next week. Our office can't turn it around any sooner.

If you object to any of this, tell me before 13:00. Otherwise it goes out.
fields.signature:
Dr. Anselm Voss
Superintendent
Fenwick Community School District

original.cc: Margo Teller, RN; Dr. Anselm Voss; Sunita Reddy, RN, CIC
original.subject: Posting at noon
original.body:
Hi,

Just a heads-up that our post goes up on the MRMC Facebook page at 12:00:

"MRMC has treated 14 patients for suspected food poisoning linked to a community event."

Your office told the radio 17 this morning. Our 14 is our own ED number, so I don't see a conflict. We're getting calls from families and need to say something.

Thanks,

Kyle Brandt
Communications Manager
Marlow Regional Medical Center
555-0173

instructorNote: This inject tests one count and one message. Under MCHD-COM-03 §5 the PIO should ask MRMC to hold its post until the PIO and the Epi Lead agree on a single figure with its tier and as-of time (24 as of 10:35, 13 of them MRMC patients, counted only once the IP confirms they meet the case definition). The PIO should also ask the superintendent to hold the letter: no food named, the Director approves it, and it goes on the MCHD school letter template. The superintendent should tell the PIO before deciding on the game, and the PIO should start the 4-hour Spanish translation as soon as the text is locked. Also watch whether the NM picks up exclusion for the two cafeteria workers and the preschool aide.
